B, feeling anxious while trying to reach dinner also makes sense. The cancellation explains why you couldn't take the planned train; it doesn't establish a lack of care. Likewise, seeming annoyed isn't the same as being annoyed. It may help to compare what each of you knew: whether the message arrived, what happened on arrival, and how each interpreted the other's behavior.
